description: Lay one of your saved sounds (a sound effect you saved, by its id from list_my_audio) or a sound in this chat onto your video at a given second, keeping the video's own sound under it unless keep_original is false. For many sounds (an effect for every movement on a timeline), pass cues instead: every sound with its second, mixed in one pass into one finished video. The picture is not changed; the finished video comes into the chat. Free.

at_seconds.description: Where the sound starts in the video, in seconds. Default 0.

cues.description: Many sounds in one pass, instead of sound_id or sound_url: each { sound_id (a saved sound) or sound_url (a sound in this chat, or the audio_url find_library_sound returned), at_seconds, volume (0 to 4, default 1) }.

keep_original.description: Keep the video's own sound under it (default true).

sound_url.description: Or a sound in this chat by its file id or name, or an https link.

video_url.description: Your video in this chat by its file id or name, or an https link.

volume.description: 0 to 4; 1 is the sound as saved. Default 1.

name: add_sound_to_video
title: Add Sound To Video
